summary: AstraZeneca furnished a Form 6-K announcing a $2 billion equity investment in newly issued Summit Therapeutics shares plus a clinical collaboration pairing its Claudin-18.2 ADC sonesitatug vedotin with Summit's PD-1/VEGF bispecific ivonescimab in gastrointestinal cancers, alongside an MOU for a broader ADC combination programme announced 29 September 2026. No stake percentage, per-share price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, close date or break fee is disclosed; each party funds trial costs and retains rights to its own medicine. Watch for pricing/ownership terms and antitrust or CFIUS review, plus any tender or change-of-control implications.
